headline: LHC directs jail authorities to arrange meeting between Noreen Niazi, her daughters
description: <p>LAHORE: The Lahore High Court (LHC) on Monday directed jail authorities to arrange a meeting between Noreen Niazi, the sister of PTI founder Imran Khan, and her two daughters on Tuesday (tomorrow).</p> <p>Justice Abher Gul Khan issued the directives while hearing petitions challenging the extensions in the detention orders of Imran’s sisters Noreen, Uzma Khan and Aleema Khanum.</p> <p>The judge also summoned the Lahore deputy commissioner to appear in person on Nov 4 and explain the extensions in the detention orders of Noreen and Uzma Khan.</p> <p>

headline: Tapping the potential of 5G
description: <p>In March, Pakistan’s three mobile operators paid about $510 million for something no one can see, hear or touch. The long-delayed 5G auction nearly tripled mobile airwaves, but airwaves alone change nothing. A licence does not teach a child, and a faster network will not, by itself, create a job or make a hospital more capable. 5G is infrastructure, and infrastructure is judged by what is built on it.
